image_description: A close-up portrait of a female graduate wearing a black academic cap (mortarboard) and gown. She is holding a rolled diploma with a yellow ribbon in her left hand and touching her face/chin with her right hand. There are significant visual artifacts, including ghosting/double-exposure effects on the hands and face, and illegible text floating in the background.
